lessons.culture: In the UAE and Kuwait, pharmacies are easy to find and many stay open late or all night; simple painkillers and cough syrup are sold over the counter, while antibiotics and stronger medicine need a prescription. challenge.title: A Visit to the Doctor and the Pharmacy
challenge.instructions: Write and act out a conversation of at least 10 lines where you tell a friend or a doctor how you feel, describe at least two symptoms using body-part words, and then go to the pharmacy to get medicine. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 9 and include both a masculine-address and a feminine-address form somewhere in your conversation.
required_elements: A question about how someone feels, like شلونك or شفيك.
At least two symptoms named with body-part words, such as راسي or بطني.
A mention of حرارة or صداع or another specific complaint.
A question asking since when the person has felt this way, using من متى.
A pharmacy or doctor request using عندك or أبي.
A question about a prescription using وصفة.
Instructions for taking medicine, such as مرتين باليوم.
A closing wish using ألف سلامة and its reply الله يسلمك.

dialogue.english: My head and my throat, and I've had a fever for two days

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.arabic: ما فيه شي خطير، بس لازم تريّح وبكتب لك وصفة
dialogue.transliteration: ma feeh shi khaTeer, bas laazim tree77 w bakteb lak waSfa
dialogue.english: Nothing serious, but you need to rest and I'll write you a prescription

dialogue.speaker: Kareem
dialogue.arabic: اللَّهُ يِسَلِّمَك دُكْتُور
dialogue.english: Thank you doctor

dialogue.speaker: Kareem
dialogue.arabic: مساء الخير، عندك دوا حسب هالوصفة؟
dialogue.english: Good evening, do you have medicine for this prescription?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.arabic: إي تفضل، خذه مرتين باليوم بعد الأكل
dialogue.transliteration: ee tfaDDal, khidhah marrateen bil-yoom ba3d il-akil
dialogue.english: Yes here, take it twice a day after eating

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.arabic: أَلْف سَلَامَة، تِصْبَح عَلَى خِير
dialogue.english: Get well soon and goodnight

dialogue.speaker: Kareem
dialogue.arabic: الله يسلمك، مشكور
dialogue.english: Thank you, many thanks
